scope.denominatorPolicy: All39 attempted frames per backend, including unclear, misleading and technical failures.
scope.independence: Purposively selected frames from5 same-uploader videos; some conversations are correlated. Not independent population samples.

categoryDefinitions.informative: Conveys the major readable meaning without material misinformation; minor names, laughter and nonessential omissions are allowed.
categoryDefinitions.justified_unclear: Major meaning remains unresolved, with explicit uncertainty justified by actual obscuration or unavoidable semantic ambiguity.
categoryDefinitions.avoidable_unclear: Readable major content was not conveyed or was replaced by a blanket refusal.
categoryDefinitions.misleading: Materially wrong or unsupported claim about a core object, actor, action, event or game state.
categoryDefinitions.no_result: No usable final answer, including transport/generation failure.

method.comparisonUnit: End-to-end final spoken-text result in a common row-input pipeline; not native whole-image OCR accuracy.
method.commonFrontend: 650x200 crop; cv2 cubic full-image3x; PP-OCRv5 detection-only common row geometry; full-width row PNGs with1 native-pixel vertical padding. Fresh preprocessing is timed independently in each arm.
method.fallback: same frozen condition: no selected team candidate at3x ->2x, use2x data instead of3x
method.selector: Same frozen selection function with common geometry and nullable-score adapter. Full-width boxes change the old native-geometry continuation behavior.

ocrBackends.local: resident PP-OCRv5 Korean mobile RapidOCR3.10.0 ONNXRuntime1.32 CPU4threads on identical row PNGs atscale1
ocrBackends.online: DeepSeek /v1/tools/ocr purpose=text_recognition, identical row PNGs; <=8 concurrent row HTTP requests per trial;30sec each, no HTTP retries

method.counterbalancedOrder: Seeded shuffled39 adjacent pairs, single outer trial;20 local-first and19 online-first.
timingExcludes: source video/image decode in successful trials
method.failureTimingNote: The retained runner-failed trial uses the outer wall timer and also includes source image read before the normal pipeline timer.
method.scoring: Anonymous AI visual/semantic review, frozen pre-inference references, backend labels joined only after all78 final scores and blind adjudications were sealed.

glyphCorrection.method: Two independent original-pixel reviews, including nearest-neighbor enlargement, before backend unblinding.

sameImageSameAnswerConsistency.reason: Sole chat line is clipped at top edge; independent adjudication agreed with frozen poor/edge-partial readability.

historicalNativeLocal39.comparisonWarning: Earlier native whole-crop local OCR pipeline and earlier AI references/review. Preprocessing, geometry, confidence policy, sampling of model outputs and later glyph adjudication differ; do not interpret score or timing changes against the paired row-input experiment as causal improvement/regression.

limitations: Shared local text detection limits both backends and is not an independently optimal online whole-image OCR pipeline.
The common full-width row geometry and uniform unknown confidence differ from the earlier native whole-image local pipeline.
AI-reviewed references and outcomes are not native-Korean human gold; some reviewers participated in earlier work, so anonymity is imperfect.
One fresh call per backend/frame includes model sampling, service and network variability.
Observed success fractions on39 selected frames are not real-user population success probabilities or a global technical optimum.
This repository evidence file intentionally excludes screenshots, videos, model weights, vendor packages, raw chat identities, generated translations, credentials and machine-specific paths.
Source artifact relative paths identify the original local archive; those large/private artifacts are not included in this small evidence file.
